1021: ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ, ਕਸਿ ਬਖਸੇ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇ. ਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
He Himself tests and accepts some; He Himself gives and takes, O brother. ॥8॥
He Himself is the bow, He Himself the archer;
He Himself is graceful, beautiful and wise.
ਕਹਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੁਣਤਾ ਸੋਈ; ਆਪੇ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
He is the speaker, the preacher and the listener; He Himself made this creation. ॥9॥
Air is the Guru, water is known as the father;
through the union of the womb, the earth is the mother.
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ; ਜਗੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਖੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Night and day are the two nurses, female and male, in whose care the world plays. ॥10॥
He Himself is the fish, He Himself the net;
He Himself is the cow, He Himself its keeper.
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਜੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Your light is in all beings of the world; all goes as God commands. ॥11॥
He Himself is the yogi, He Himself the enjoyer;
He Himself is the reveller, in the supreme union.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
He Himself, the Formless, dwells in the wilderness, absorbed fearlessly in trance. ॥12॥
The sources of life and speech merge in You;
all that is seen comes and goes.
ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
They alone are true bankers and traders to whom the True Guru has given understanding. ॥13॥
The Perfect True Guru imparts understanding of the Word.
O True One, You are full of all powers;
ਅਫਰਿਓ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ; ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
none can turn You back; You are ever carefree, without a particle of greed. ॥14॥
Birth and death are driven mad
for one who enjoys within the Word and the essence of poise.
ਆਪੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
He Himself grants liberation, contentment and blessings to one whose mind loves devotion with love. ॥15॥
He Himself is unattached; through the Guru He is reached and known.
All that is seen merges into You.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ. ਭਿਖਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਚੈ; ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥
Lowly Nanak begs alms at Your door: grant me the glory of Your Name. ॥16॥1॥
He Himself is the earth, the bull that supports it, and the sky;
He Himself reveals the virtues of the True One.
ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He Himself is the celibate, the charitable and the contented; He Himself does the deeds. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਣਾ; ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
He whose creation it is creates and watches over it;
no one can erase the True One's decree.
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He Himself does and causes to be done; He Himself bestows glory. ॥2॥
The five thieves lead the fickle mind astray;
ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜੋਹਹਿ; ਘਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਭਾਲਹਿ ॥
they eye others' homes and do not search their own.
ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਢਹੈ. ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਪਤਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The body-city crumbles into a heap; without the Word one's honour is lost. ॥3॥
One who understands through the Guru sees the Lord in the three worlds,
and, subduing desire, wrestles with the mind.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਤੁਧ ਹੀ ਜੇਹੇ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Those who serve You become like You, O Fearless One, the companion from childhood. ॥4॥
He Himself is heaven, this world and the underworld;
He Himself is the embodiment of light, ever young.
ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਸਰੂਪੀ; ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
He wears matted hair, terrible and fierce, yet He has no form or feature. ॥5॥
The Vedas and the Semitic scriptures have not known His mystery;
ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ॥
He has no mother, father, son or brother.
ਸਗਲੇ ਸੈਲ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਏ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
He created all the mountains and absorbs them again; the Unseen cannot be seen. ॥6॥
I have grown weary of making many friends;
no one can cut away my faults.
ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ; ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ. ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
He is the Master of gods and men, Lord over all; when He is met through love, fear departs. ॥7॥
Those who stray and err You set on the path;
You Yourself lead astray and You Yourself instruct.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ; ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Without the Name I see no other; through the Name one knows His state and extent. ॥8॥
1022: The Ganges, the Jamuna, Brindaban where Krishna played, Kedar,
ਗੰਗਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੇਣੀ ਸੰਗਮੁ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Ganga Sagar and the confluence of Triveni — the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are contained in His lap. ॥9॥
He Himself is the Siddha, the seeker and the contemplative;
He Himself is the king and the appointer of chiefs.
ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹੈ ਅਦਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ; ਭਰਮੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
God Himself sits on the throne as the Just One; doubt, separation and fear depart. ॥10॥
He Himself is the Qazi, He Himself the Mullah;
He Himself is infallible and never errs.
ਆਪੇ ਮਿਹਰ ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੋ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
He Himself is the merciful Master of compassion, the Giver; He is no one's enemy. ॥11॥
Whomever He forgives, He blesses with glory;
He is the Giver to all, without a particle of greed.
ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ; ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The Unattached One pervades and supports all, hidden and manifest in all places. ॥12॥
How can I praise the Unreachable, Infinite One,
the True Creator, Slayer of demons?
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
On whom He casts His glance He unites; united, one stays united as He unites. ॥13॥
Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva at His door
stand and serve the Unseen, Infinite One.
ਹੋਰ ਕੇਤੀ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੀ; ਮੈ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
So many others are seen wailing at His door that I cannot count them. ॥14॥
True is His praise, true His Word;
in the Vedas and Puranas I see nothing else.
ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ; ਮੈ ਧਰ ਹੋਰ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Truth is my capital; I sing the praises of the True One; I have no other support. ॥15॥
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
Through the ages He is True; He is, and will be.
ਕਉਣੁ. ਨ ਮੂਆ; ਕਉਣੁ. ਨ ਮਰਸੀ ॥
Who has not died? Who will not die?
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ; ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੨॥
Lowly Nanak offers this prayer: at Your door You watch over all with attention. ॥16॥2॥
Duality and evil-mindedness make one blind and deaf;
the bodice of lust and anger is flimsy.
ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਛੋਹਰਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨੀਦ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The Husband is in the home, yet the foolish girl does not know Him or poise; without her Husband she finds no sleep. ॥1॥
the self-willed one looks in all four directions.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਾਚੇ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Without serving the True Guru how can one find peace? Glory is in the hands of the True One. ॥2॥
One who casts off lust, anger and ego,
and through the Word destroys the five thieves,
ਗਿਆਨ ਖੜਗੁ ਲੈ. ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
takes the sword of wisdom and wrestles with the mind, and desire is absorbed within the mind. ॥3॥
ਮਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ; ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
From the mother's blood and the father's seed,
You, the Infinite, fashioned the form and the face.
ਜੋਤਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The light and all the gifts are Yours; You are the Creator in all places. ॥4॥
You Yourself made birth and death;
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਮਝ ਪੜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਡਰਣਾ ॥
one who has understood through the Guru — why should he fear?
ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
You are merciful; when You look with mercy, pain and suffering leave the body. ॥5॥
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹੇ; ਭਉ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
Those who sit in their own home have consumed fear;
they have restrained the running mind and held it still.
ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਾਸ ਹਰੇ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The lotus blossoms, the pools are green and brimming; the all-pervading Lord is their companion. ॥6॥
With death decreed, people come into the world;
how can one stay? One must go to the world beyond.
ਸਚਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪੁਰਿ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
True is the command; those who dwell in the True One's eternal city meet the True One and receive glory. ॥7॥
He Himself created the whole world;
He who fashioned it set it to its tasks.
1023: ਸਚੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
No one is seen above the True One; who can appraise the True One? ॥8॥
Here we are like herdsmen camped for four days;
the world is a play, a show, amid pitch darkness.
ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ; ਜਿਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭਖਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The jugglers play their game and depart, like one who mutters in a dream at night. ॥9॥
They are blessed with glory upon the throne
in whose minds the Fearless One dwells, lovingly attuned.
ਖੰਡੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਪੁਰੀਈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
He is absorbed in trance in the continents, the galaxies, the underworlds, the realms and the three worlds. ॥10॥
True is the city, true the throne,
of the one who meets the True One through the Guru and finds peace.
ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
On the true throne of the True One is glory; such a one has cast off ego and calculation. ॥11॥
Reckoning and calculating, the soul is in anxiety;
how can one find peace in duality and the three qualities?
ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The One Immaculate, Pure Lord is the Giver; through the Perfect Guru honour is obtained. ॥12॥
In every age, rare is the one who knows Him through the Guru.
The True One is all-pervading; the mind is dyed in His love.
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Taking His shelter, one has found peace; there is no filth in mind or body. ॥13॥
The tongue is dyed with the True One, the source of nectar;
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੀ; ਭਉ. ਨ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
with the Lord God as companion there is no fear or doubt.
ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਰਜੇ, ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The ears are satisfied with the Guru's Word, and one's light merges with the Light. ॥14॥
ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ਧਰੇ ਪਉ ਧਰਣਾ ॥
Carefully, carefully one places one's feet upon the earth;
wherever I look, I see Your refuge.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
Whether You give pain or pleasure, You are pleasing to my mind; my bond is with You alone. ॥15॥
At the very end no one is one's friend;
knowing this through the Guru, I praise You.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੩॥
Nanak, those imbued with the Name are detached, absorbed in trance in their own home. ॥16॥3॥
From the beginning, through the ages, You are boundless and infinite,
ਸਾਚੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
O True One, You contemplated the way of union, and You, the True One, were absorbed in trance. ॥1॥
For how many ages, in pitch darkness,
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
True is His Name, true His glory; glory is on the true throne. ॥2॥
In the Golden Age, truth and contentment fill the body;
the profound, unfathomable Lord pervades as Truth upon Truth.
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਖੈ; ਸਾਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The True Master tests by Truth and makes all move by His true command. ॥3॥
The Perfect True Guru is truthful and contented;
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨੇ; ਸੋ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
one who accepts the Guru's Word is a hero.
ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ; ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Such a one dwells truly in the true court, obeying the command of the Sovereign of the will. ॥4॥
In the Golden Age everyone speaks the Truth;
one lives in Truth, and sees only the True One.
ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ, ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Truth in mind and mouth, the Destroyer of doubt and fear — the True One is the companion of the Guru-facing. ॥5॥
In the Silver Age, one power of Dharma was lost;
three feet remained, and duality dried up one.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One who turns to the Guru speaks the Truth; the self-willed waste away in vain. ॥6॥
The self-willed never succeed in the Lord's court;
without the Word, how can one be pleased within?
ਬਾਧੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Bound they come and bound they go; they have no understanding or sense. ॥7॥
In the Brass Age, compassion was reduced to half;
1024: rare is the one who, through the Guru, understands.
ਦੁਇ ਪਗ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਣੀਧਰ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਤਿਥਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
The Sustainer of the earth kept Dharma on two feet; for the Guru-facing, Truth is there. ॥8॥
Kings practise righteousness for their own ends;
bound by hope, they give in charity.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Without the Lord's Name there is no liberation; they grow weary of performing rituals. ॥9॥
Performing rituals and religious deeds, they ask for liberation;
the treasure of liberation comes from praising the Lord through the Word.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Without the Guru's Word there is no liberation; He created the world and leads people astray. ॥10॥
Possessiveness for Maya cannot be abandoned;
they alone are freed who do the true work,
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ; ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
who, imbued with devotion day and night, reflect on Him and are bonded with the Master. ॥11॥
ਇਕਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some chant, practise austerities and bathe at places of pilgrimage;
as it pleases You, so You make them walk.
ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ, ਅਪਤੀਜੁ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ, ਕਿਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
By stubborn restraint the faithless mind is not softened; without the Lord and Guru, who has obtained honour? ॥12॥
ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਿ; ਇਕ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
In the Dark Age only one power of Dharma remains;
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਭਾਖੀ ॥
without the Perfect Guru no one has told of it.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Among the self-willed falsehood prevails; without the True Guru doubt does not depart. ॥13॥
The True Guru is the carefree Creator,
ਨਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਣਿ; ਨ ਛੰਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ॥
with no fear of Death and no dependence on people.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸੋ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Whoever serves him becomes imperishable; death does not torment that one. ॥14॥
The Creator has placed Himself within the Guru;
through the Guru He saves countless millions.
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਮੈਲੁ, ਨ ਕਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
He is the Life of the world, the Giver to all beings, fearless and without any filth. ॥15॥
All beg from the Guru, the treasurer,
of the Immaculate, Unseen, Infinite One.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚੈ; ਮੈ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੪॥
Nanak speaks the Truth and begs of God: grant me Truth, O Sovereign of the will. ॥16॥4॥
Those whom the True One unites, He unites through the Word;
when it pleases Him, they merge in poise.
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
The Transcendent Lord has placed His light in the three worlds; there is no other, O brother. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Whose servants they are, Him they serve;
the Unseen, Inscrutable One is pleased through the Word.
ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਕਰਤਾ; ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The Creator bestows virtue on His devotees; He forgives them and grants glory. ॥2॥
The True One gives and gives, and never runs short;
the shallow take and take, then deny it.
ਮੂਲੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ, ਸਾਚਿ. ਨ ਰੀਝਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
They do not understand the Root and take no delight in the True One; they are led astray by duality and doubt. ॥3॥
The Guru-facing remain awake day and night;
through the Guru's teaching they know the love of the True One.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਸੇ ਲੂਟੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The self-willed stay asleep and are plundered; the Guru-facing remain intact, O brother. ॥4॥
In falsehood one comes, in falsehood one goes;
imbued with falsehood, one practises falsehood.
ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ. ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Those united with the Word are robed with honour in the court; the Guru-facing are absorbed in awareness. ॥5॥
Plundered by falsehood, her garden is robbed by thieves,
like a garden laid waste in the wilderness.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦਿ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Without the Name nothing tastes sweet; forgetting the Lord she suffers pain. ॥6॥
Obtaining the food of Truth, one is satisfied;
the jewel of the Name is true glory.
ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ. ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
One who examines oneself recognises Him, and one's light merges in the Light. ॥7॥
1025: Strayed from the Name, she suffers blows;
with all her cleverness, her doubt does not depart.
ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਚੇਤ. ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ; ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
The heedless who do not remember Him waste away and die, loaded with a monstrous burden. ॥8॥
No one is without quarrels and conflict;
show me such a one, and I will praise him.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Offering mind and body, one meets the Life of the world, and forms a bond with the Lord. ॥9॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
No one knows God's state and extent;
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ; ਵਡਾਈ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
one who calls himself great is consumed by his greatness.
ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ. ਤੋਟਿ, ਨ ਦਾਤੀ; ਸਗਲੀ. ਤਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The True Master's gifts never run short; He created all. ॥10॥
Great is the glory of the Carefree One;
He Himself creates and provides sustenance.
ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹੀ, ਦਾਤਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
The merciful Giver is not far; the Sovereign of the will is met in poise. ॥11॥
Some are in sorrow, some gripped by disease;
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ॥
whatever He does, He does Himself.
ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਅਨਹਦਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Through loving devotion and the Guru's perfect teaching, one is shown Him through the unstruck Word. ॥12॥
Some go naked and hungry, wandering about;
ਇਕਿ ਹਠੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
some die in stubborn practices and do not know the worth of life.
ਗਤਿ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
They do not know the state of the Unseen; one who lives the Word understands. ॥13॥
ਇਕਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹਿ; ਅੰਨੁ. ਨ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some bathe at places of pilgrimage and eat no grain;
some kindle fires and torment their bodies.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Without the Lord's Name there is no liberation; by what means can one cross over? ॥14॥
Abandoning the Guru's teaching, they go into the wilderness;
the perverse, self-willed one does not chant the Lord.
ਪਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ. ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਕੂੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
They waste away and drown, practising falsehood; through falsehood death becomes their enemy. ॥15॥
By His command one comes, by His command one goes;
one who understands the command merges in the True One.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੫॥
Nanak, one who works through the Guru meets the True One and is pleasing to His mind. ॥16॥5॥
He Himself is the Creator, the Primal Being, the Architect of destiny,
who created Himself and recognised His creation.
ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He Himself is the True Guru, He Himself the servant; He Himself created the universe. ॥1॥
He Himself is near, not far;
those who understand this through the Guru are perfect.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ; ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਏਹ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
In their company there is profit day and night; such is the glory of the Guru's company. ॥2॥
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
In every age Your saints are good, O God;
they sing the Lord's praises, relishing them with the tongue.
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ; ਜਿਨ. ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
They praise You and cast off pain and poverty; they look to no one else. ॥3॥
ਓਇ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹਹਿ; ਨ ਸੂਤੇ ਦੀਸਹਿ ॥
They remain awake and are never seen asleep;
their company saves generations; they serve out Truth.
ਕਲਿਮਲ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਓਇ ਰਹਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
They have no filth of sin; they are pure, ever lovingly absorbed in devotion. ॥4॥
O people of the Lord, understand the True Guru's Word:
ਏਹੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਦੇਹ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ॥
this youth, this breath, this body grow old.
ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Today or tomorrow one must die, O mortal; chant the Lord and meditate on Him in the heart. ॥5॥
O mortal, give up false rubbish;
falsehood is struck down by Death, who leaps upon it.
ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜਿ ਪਚਹਿ. ਮਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ; ਦੁਹੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The faithless waste away in falsehood, with ego in the mind; on the path of duality they are ruined. ॥6॥
1026: Give up slandering and envying others;
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ; ਸਾਤਿ. ਨ ਆਈ ॥
those who do so burn and burn, and find no peace.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਹੁ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
Join the true congregation and praise the Name; the all-pervading Lord becomes your companion. ॥7॥
Give up lust, anger and wickedness;
give up the entanglement of ego and lechery.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਹੁ. ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹੁ; ਇਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Seek the True Guru's refuge and you will be saved; thus is the terrifying world-ocean crossed, O brother. ॥8॥
ਆਗੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਦੀ; ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਝੇਲਾ ॥
Ahead lies a river of pure fire and poisonous flames;
ਤਿਥੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਜੀਉ ਇਕੇਲਾ ॥
there is no one else there; the soul is alone.
ਭੜ ਭੜ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇ ਲਹਰੀ; ਪੜਿ ਦਝਹਿ. ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The ocean of fire roars with waves; the self-willed fall in and burn. ॥9॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇ ਭਾਣੈ ॥
Liberation is with the Guru; he gives the gift by his will.
One who has received it knows the way;
ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਭਾਈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
ask those who have received it, O brother: peace comes through serving the True Guru. ॥10॥
Without the Guru, people die entangled in vice;
Death strikes them on the head and disgraces them.
ਬਾਧੇ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ, ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ; ਡੂਬਹਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Bound, slanderers find no release; they drown in slandering others. ॥11॥
Speak the Truth and recognise Him within;
He is not far; look with attention and see.
ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ; ਇਉ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
No obstacle comes; through the Guru swim across; thus He carries one over the world-ocean. ॥12॥
The Name dwells within the body;
ਨਾ ਜੀਉ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The soul does not die, nor can it be killed; the Sovereign of the will creates and watches over all through His Word. ॥13॥
He is immaculate; there is no darkness in Him;
the True One Himself sits upon the throne.
ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਆਈ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
The faithless, bound by falsehood, are made to wander; they die and are born, coming and going. ॥14॥
The Guru's servants are dear to the True Guru;
ਓਇ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਤਖਤਿ; ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
they sit on the throne, reflecting on the Word.
ਤਤੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
They find the essence and know the inner state; in the true congregation is true glory. ॥15॥
The Lord's servant swims across and carries his ancestors across too;
his company liberates, and he carries others across.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਲਾਲਾ ਗੋਲਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੬॥
Nanak is the slave and servant of one who, through the Guru, is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥16॥6॥
For so many ages there was only darkness;
the boundless, infinite One was absorbed in trance.
ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ; ਨਾ ਤਦਿ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
In pitch darkness He sat unattached; there was no worldly business or expanse then. ॥1॥
He made thirty-six ages pass in this way;
as it pleased Him, so He made things move.
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਈ; ਆਪੇ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
No rival to Him is seen; He Himself is boundless and infinite. ॥2॥
Know Him hidden throughout the four ages;
He pervades every heart and is within every womb.
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕਾ ਏਕੀ ਵਰਤੈ; ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Age after age the One alone pervades; rare is the one who understands through reflecting on the Guru. ॥3॥
Seed and blood combined to form the body;
air, water and fire combined to make the living being.
ਆਪੇ ਚੋਜ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ; ਹੋਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
He Himself plays in the mansion of the body; the rest is the expanse of attachment to Maya. ॥4॥
In the coil of the womb, upside down, one meditates;
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
With each breath one remembers the True Name, deep within the womb. ॥5॥
1027: One comes into the world with the four blessings,
and takes up residence in the home of Shiva and Shakti — in Maya.
ਏਕੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ. ਤਾ ਪਿੜ ਹਾਰੇ; ਅੰਧੁਲੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Forgetting the One, one loses the game; the blind one has forgotten the Name. ॥6॥
A child dies, and its childish play
is recalled again and again as they weep: "Such a lively child!"
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ. ਸੋ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਲੀਆ; ਭੂਲਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
He to whom it belonged has taken it back; the one who weeps is mistaken. ॥7॥
ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ. ਕਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
If one dies in the fullness of youth, what can be done?
ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਰੋਇ ਵਿਗੂਚਹਿ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
They weep and are ruined for the sake of Maya; cursed is such a life in the world. ॥8॥
Black hair turns white at last;
without the Name one loses one's capital and departs.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਮੂਠੇ ਰੋਇ ਪੂਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Blind in evil-mindedness one perishes again and again; plundered, one weeps and cries out. ॥9॥
One who reflects on oneself does not weep;
when one meets the True Guru, understanding comes.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ, ਨ ਖੂਲਹਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Without the Guru the heavy, rigid doors do not open; through the Word one is released. ॥10॥
One grows old, and the body wastes away;
yet one does not chant the Lord, the friend at the end.
ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ. ਚਲੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ; ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Forgetting the Name, one departs with a blackened face; the false are disgraced in the court. ॥11॥
The false one departs, having forgotten the Name;
coming and going, ashes fall on his head.
ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
He finds no place in his in-laws' home, the world beyond, and is beaten in his parents' home, this world. ॥12॥
One eats, dresses and makes merry,
but without loving devotion one dies in vain.
ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
One who does not know good from bad is struck by Death; what remedy is there? ॥13॥
One who, amid worldly activity, knows detachment,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
in the Guru's company, through the Word, knows the true home,
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖਿ. ਨ ਚਲੈ; ਸਚਿ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
does not go about calling anyone bad; such a one, true in Truth, is genuine. ॥14॥
ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ; ਦਰਿ ਸਿਝੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Without Truth no one succeeds at the Lord's door;
through the true Word one is robed and honoured.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
He Himself forgives those pleasing to Him, and they cast off ego and pride. ॥15॥
By the Guru's grace one recognises the command,
and knows the way through the ages.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੭॥
Nanak, chant the Name and swim across; the True One, the Saviour, carries one over. ॥16॥1॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
I have no friend like the Lord,
ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ. ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੋਈ ॥
who gave me body and mind and placed awareness within.
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ; ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He cherishes and cares for all beings; He is within, all-wise and all-seeing. ॥1॥
The Guru is the pool; we are his beloved swans.
ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ; ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
In the ocean are many jewels and rubies;
ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਗਾਵਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
the Lord's praise is pearls, gems and diamonds; singing it, mind and body are drenched. ॥2॥
The Lord is unreachable, unfathomable, profound and unattached;
ਹਰਿ. ਅੰਤੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
no end of the Lord, the great Guru and Sustainer of the world, can be found.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ; ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Through the True Guru's teaching the Saviour carries one across; He unites one with Himself, absorbed in His love. ॥3॥
Without the True Guru, how can there be liberation?
He has been the Lord's beloved from the beginning, through the ages.
ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਬਖਸੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
In His mercy He grants liberation in His court and forgives the faults one has committed. ॥4॥
1028: The True Guru, the Giver, brings liberation;
ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਏ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
he removes all disease and gives the ambrosial essence.
ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਠਰੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
Death, the tax-collector, levies no tax on one whose fire is quenched and whose heart is cool. ॥5॥
The swan-soul has formed a great love for the body;
ਓਹੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਓਹ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
he is the yogi, and she the beautiful woman.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਚੋਜ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤੈ. ਮਤਾ, ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
Day and night he enjoys her in play and delight; when he rises to depart, he does not even consult her. ॥6॥
Creating the universe, God spreads His canopy over it;
in air, water and fire He resounds.
ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The mind wavers, keeping company with the demons; it receives the fruit of whatever it has done. ॥7॥
Forgetting the Name, one suffers faults and pain;
when the command to depart comes, how can one stay?
ਨਰਕ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗੋਤੇ ਖਾਵੈ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਮੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
One sinks into the pit of hell, like a fish out of water. ॥8॥
The faithless are made to endure the 8.4 million hells;
as one acts, so one receives.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਨ ਹੋਈ; ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Without the True Guru there is no liberation; bound by past deeds one is seized. ॥9॥
The path is like a sword's edge, a very narrow lane;
the account is taken, and one is crushed like sesame.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ. ਮੁਕਤਿ, ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
Mother, father, wife and son are no help; without the Lord's essence there is no liberation. ॥10॥
How many friends and companions there are in the world,
yet without the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, there is no one.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Service to the Guru is the support of liberation; night and day sing the praises of the Lord. ॥11॥
Abandon falsehood and run toward the True One,
and you will obtain the fruit you desire.
ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਿਰਲੇ; ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
Rare are the traders in the merchandise of Truth; they make the deal and earn the profit. ॥12॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ॥
Take the merchandise of the Lord's Name with you as you go,
and you will behold His vision in His mansion of poise.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ; ਇਉ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਚੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The perfect, Guru-facing ones search and find; thus they recognise the One who sees all alike. ॥13॥
God is infinite; few find Him through the Guru's teaching,
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ ॥
instructing their minds through the Guru's Word.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਇਉ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Accept the True Guru's Word as true, utterly true; thus one merges in the all-pervading Lord. ॥14॥
Narad and Sharda are Your servants;
in the three worlds the greatest of the great are Your servants.
ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ. ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
All creation is Yours; You are the Giver over every head; all this is Your making. ॥15॥
Some serve at Your door, and their pain is dispelled;
they are robed with honour in the court; the True Guru has freed them.
ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ; ਚਿਤੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚਲਣਿ. ਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
The True Guru has broken the bonds of ego and does not let the fickle mind wander. ॥16॥
Meet the True Guru and learn that way
ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
by which you will find God and have no account to render.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੨॥੮॥
Conquer ego and serve the Guru; servant Nanak, such a one is drenched in the Lord's love. ॥17॥2॥8॥
My Lord is the Slayer of demons;
the beloved, all-pervading Lord dwells in every heart.
ਨਾਲੇ ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੂਲੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
He is with us, yet the Unseen cannot be seen at all; through the Guru, inscribe His reflection within. ॥1॥
The Guru-facing, the holy, seek Your refuge;
1029: in His mercy God has carried them across.
ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਗਹਰਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The ocean of fire is very deep; the Guru, the True Guru, carries one across. ॥2॥
The blind, self-willed have no understanding;
they come and go, dying again and again.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਮਿਟਈ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਖੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
The destiny written by past deeds is not erased; the blind are disgraced at Death's door. ॥3॥
ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some come and go and find no place in their own home;
bound by past deeds, they commit sins.
ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਕਾਈ; ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
The blind have no sense or understanding; greed and ego are evil. ॥4॥
ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰਾ ॥
Without her Husband, what use is the bride's adornment?
Imbued with another man, she has forgotten her Master.
ਜਿਉ ਬੇਸੁਆ ਪੂਤ. ਬਾਪੁ, ਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਤਿਉ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
As the son of a prostitute cannot name his father, so are her empty, sinful deeds. ॥5॥
In the skeleton of a ghost there is great pain;
they rot in hell, in the darkness of ignorance.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
The debt owed to the Righteous Judge is collected from one who has forgotten the Lord's Name. ॥6॥
The sun blazes, with flames of poisonous fire;
the self-willed is a disgraced beast, a demon.
ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਰੋਗੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
In hope and desire they practise falsehood; theirs is the worst of diseases. ॥7॥
With a heavy load on the forehead, a load of salty earth on the head,
how can one cross the terrifying world-ocean?
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ. ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
From the beginning, through the ages, the True Guru is the boat; through the Lord's Name one is carried across. ॥8॥
In the world, love of children and spouse is dear;
the expanse of attachment to Maya is spread everywhere.
ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤੋੜੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
The True Guru has broken the nooses of Death for the Guru-facing who reflect on the essence. ॥9॥
Plundered by falsehood, she wanders down many paths;
the self-willed falls into the fire again and again and burns.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The Guru, the great wise one, gives the ambrosial Name; chant the Name, the essence of peace. ॥10॥
The True Guru, when pleased, implants Truth,
removes all pain and sets one on the path.
ਕੰਡਾ ਪਾਇ. ਨ ਗਡਈ ਮੂਲੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Not even a thorn pierces the foot of one whom the True Guru protects. ॥11॥
Dust mingles with dust, and the body wastes away;
the self-willed is like stone, a rock, and is not softened.
ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
He pleads and wails a great deal, and is born into hell and heaven. ॥12॥
Maya is poison, the companion of the snake;
this duality has ruined many homes.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, ਨ ਉਪਜੈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
Without the True Guru love does not well up; those imbued with devotion are content. ॥13॥
The faithless run after Maya a great deal;
forgetting the Name, where can they find peace?
ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Caught in the three qualities they waste away and ruin others; they are not carried across. ॥14॥
The false are called dogs and swine;
they bark themselves to death, barking and barking in fear.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ. ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
False in mind and body, they practise falsehood; through evil-mindedness they lose in the court. ॥15॥
When one meets the True Guru, the mind is steadied;
he gives the Lord's Name to one who seeks his refuge.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥
He gives the priceless wealth of the Lord's Name; the Lord's praise is beloved in His court. ॥16॥
1030: The Lord's Name is obtained in the refuge of the holy Guru;
through the True Guru's words one knows His state and extent.
ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੭॥੩॥੯॥
Nanak, chant the Lord, O my mind; the Uniter unites one with the Lord. ॥17॥3॥9॥
ਘਰਿ ਰਹੁ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨੇ ॥
Stay in your own home, O foolish, ignorant mind;
chant the Lord, meditating deep within.
ਲਾਲਚ ਛੋਡਿ. ਰਚਹੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ; ਇਉ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Give up greed and merge in the Infinite; thus you will find the door of liberation. ॥1॥
Forgetting Him, Death begins to stalk you;
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ; ਦੁਖਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥
all peace departs, and pain lies ahead.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਅੜੇ; ਏਹੁ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
O my soul, chant the Lord's Name through the Guru; this is the supreme essence to reflect on. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ; ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name; its taste is sweet;
through the Guru, the Lord's essence is seen within.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਏਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Remain imbued with the Lord's love day and night; this is the essence of chanting, austerity and self-discipline. ॥3॥
Speak the Lord's Name through the Guru's word;
ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਹਿ; ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੋਲਹੁ ॥
seek this essence in the society of the saints.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਗਰਭ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
Through the Guru's teaching search out and find your own home, and you will not enter the womb again. ॥4॥
ਸਚੁ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
Bathe at the shrine of Truth and sing the Lord's praises;
reflect on the essence and be lovingly attuned to the Lord.
ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
At the very end Death cannot touch you; speak the Name of the beloved Lord. ॥5॥
The True Guru, the Primal Being, is the Giver, greatly wise;
ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ; ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
one within whom is Truth merges in the Word.
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਭਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
One whom the True Guru unites with himself is rid of the heavy burden of the fear of Death. ॥6॥
The body is formed by joining the five elements;
ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ; ਲੈ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
within it, search out and find the jewel of the Lord.
ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ. ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
The soul is the Lord, and the Lord is the soul; the Lord is found by reflecting on the Word. ॥7॥
Live in truth and contentment, O brothers;
hold fast to forgiveness in the True Guru's refuge.
ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਿ. ਪਰਾਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
Know your own soul, and know the soul of others; in the Guru's company there is this release. ॥8॥
The faithless rely on falsehood and deceit;
day and night they slander in countless ways.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ. ਆਵਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਗ੍ਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਰਕ ਮਝਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
Without remembrance they come and go, cast into the womb, births and hell. ॥9॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ. ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
The faithless are never free of the fear of Death;
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮੂਕੈ ॥
Death's club is never withdrawn from them.
ਬਾਕੀ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਲੀਜੈ; ਸਿਰਿ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
The debt owed to the Righteous Judge is collected; the proud carry an unbearable load on their heads. ॥10॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਸਾਕਤੁ. ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
Tell me, without the Guru, what faithless one has crossed over?
Acting in ego, one falls into the terrifying world-ocean.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਪਾਰੁ, ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
Without the Guru no one reaches the far shore; meditating on the Lord, one is carried across. ॥11॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
No one can erase the Guru's gift;
whomever he forgives, he carries across.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਨਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
The pain of birth and death does not come near one in whose mind is that boundless, infinite God. ॥12॥
Strayed from the Guru, you come and go;
you are born and die, and commit sins again.
ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਅਚੇਤ. ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
The foolish, heedless faithless do not remember the Lord; when pain strikes, then they cry out to the Lord. ॥13॥
ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ; ਪੁਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
Pleasure and pain come from deeds of past births;
the Giver who gave them knows.
ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਸਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
Whom can you blame, O mortal? Bear the hard fruit of your own deeds. ॥14॥
